newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai, Malaysian phone firms in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Thai, Malaysian phone firms in joint venture.

text.p: Major Thai telecommunications firm Samart Corp Plc said on Wednesday that Telekom Malaysia Bhd is to invest $251 million with it in a joint venture in Thailand.

A spokeswoman for Samart Corp told Reuters that the joint venture agreement would be signed at a Bangkok hotel on Monday, June 9. He declined to specify the nature of the venture or say how much his firm would invest.
Details would be disclosed after the signing of the agreement, he added.

She said Chatichai Choonhavan, chairman of the Thai Prime Minister's Advisory Committee for Economic and Foreign Affairs, Leo Moggie, Malaysia's Minister of Energy, Post and Telecommunications, and Thai Transport and Communications Minister Suwat Liptapallop would preside over the signing.
